free_tier.stated: 1024 GB of free cloud storage on registration
free_tier.notes: the free allowance is 1024 GB and the pricing page labels it limited-time

per_object_cap.stated: 4 GB per single file on the web for non-Premium users; Premium users can upload single files up to 128 GB from the app
per_object_cap.notes: the vendor FAQ states 4 GB per file for non-Premium users and 128 GB for Premium; the login page's 'Upload and share 20GB files on PC' is a marketing figure not reconciled with the FAQ

retention.stated: inactive files on free accounts are removed after 60 days; Premium files are retained indefinitely

egress.terms: multi-file downloads from the web app are limited to 500 MB, while single-file downloads have no size limit

tooling: no official public API documented; the OpenList project ships a reverse-engineered TeraBox driver that authenticates with a browser session cookie and is not maintained, so a reverse-engineered client mounts it with fragility
chaining: 1 TiB free is the largest single-tier free quota in the consumer set, but every route to it is either an app or an undocumented API

limits.value: 4 GB per file for non-Premium users; 128 GB for Premium from the app

identity_cost.detail: the email path submits an email address, a password, a user name, a date of birth and a verification code; the payload carries no phone number, card or identity-document field

reliability_note: The landing page served a verification interstitial; the quota was read from the login page and the web app bundle instead.
